review_comments.body: The tests in this file are garbage

### SDK may reject new default model **High Severity** The default is now `claude-sonnet-5-5`, which rejects forced `tool_choice`, `thinking: disabled`, and sampling params with HTTP 400. The lockfile still pins `@ai-sdk/anthropic@3.0.33` (January 2026), before that model existed. Embedded agents call `generateText` with `experimental_output`, which older Anthropic providers often implement as a hidden JSON tool with named `tool_choice`. If that path is used, Anthropic-backed search tools fail immediately rather than after the old model retires.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 494708e2fcf3e7313b16f661ea0236a98cbbd876. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

Confirmed and fixed in 7008e8dd.

I checked the request bodies against a mocked fetch, using the same `generateText` + `Output.object` + `prepareStep` setup as `callEmbeddedAgent`:

- **`@ai-sdk/anthropic@3.0.33`:** `claude-sonnet-5-5` is an unknown model, so the SDK falls back to the hidden `json` tool and sends `tool_choice: {type: "any"}` on every step, including the `toolChoice: "none"` finalize step. It also caps `max_tokens` at 4096. Sonnet 5.5 rejects forced tool choice with a 400, so every Anthropic-backed embedded agent call would fail.
- **`@ai-sdk/anthropic@3.0.137` (current `ai-v6` tag):** the SDK knows the model. It sends `tool_choice: auto`/`none`, native `output_config.format`, no sampling params and `max_tokens: 128000`, and it passes the thinking blocks back unchanged in the tool loop.

The fix bumps the catalog to `^3.0.137` and also corrects the stale default in `docs/operations/embedded-agents.md`. `tsc`, `lint` and the mcp-core tests pass.
